==English==
{{wp|+ (surname)}}

===Etymology===
Various origins:
* [[English]] metonymic occupational surname for a cobbler, from {{m|en|last|t=a tool for shaping shoes|id=tool}}. Compare {{m|en|Laster}}.
* Also as an English surname, from the adjective {{m|en|last}}.
* Borrowed from {{bor|en|nl|-}} and {{bor|en|de|Last}}, an occupational surname for a porter (see the German entry below).

===Proper noun===
{{en-proper noun|s}}

# {{surname|en}}.

====Statistics====
* According to the 2010 United States Census, ''Last'' is the 15922<sup>nd</sup> most common surname in the United States, belonging to 1825 individuals. ''Last'' is most common among White (92.66%) individuals.
